headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: Watr -attaching a decibel reading from my balcony across the street. This is not okay!!!!!!!!!!!!! SHUT THEM DOWN

Watr Rooftop - excuse me?!? 3 nights in a roll blasting music after midnight - with no intention to tune it down even a tiny bit after 10:30 or midnight ?!? 

How is Watr Rooftop still getting away with this? Did the investigation team do their job from theirq home ?!?

There is a new late night club opening one block from our house on Thursday in a space we have already complained about. HOW IS THIS EVEN POSSIBLE??? This is a residential neighborhood. Do they have a license until 12 midnight? It is where Marisol Del Sol at 1209 E 7th was. The place is derelict inside so we can only assume this is an outdoor event.  What can we do??
Watr Rooftop blasting music again!!! It is so loud it shakes my apartment 3 nights a week. The noise needs to be managed!!!

URGENT NOISE COMPLAINT — WATR ROOFTOP, 96 RED RIVER STREET, AUSTIN, TX

It is past midnight, and Watr Rooftop at 96 Red River Street continues to blast excessively loud DJ music, making it impossible to sleep even with all windows closed and earplugs in.

It’s the second time this happened this week - It is outrageous that a commercial establishment shows such blatant disregard for nearby resident
WATR BAR is soooo loud!!! Everything is shaking. Absolutely impossible to even watch tv. Sleeping is impossible. Why is nothing ever being done to fix this!

Watr Rooftop, 96 Red River St AGAIN blasting music after Midnight - making it impossible for me or my 6 months old infant to go to sleep.

How many times does this place need to be reported before something actually changes? Please send someone to investigate and pls do it on a non-street level as they’re not even on the street …. 
In the response - pls tell us if they have outdoor music permit. P

This loud pounding music event at Naya in West Ave and 5th street  has been non stop since noon.. please somebody help with this noise.  This restaurant was described as Asian fusion and it’s become a loud outdoor special event with no concerns to the residents of Austin City Lofts that live next to it. I share a wall with the back of the restaurant.  I have children that need to sleep for school.

ROY VELASQUEZ SR COMPLEX 
Capuchino Softball Field

Hi, I understand that the event is scheduled to continue until 2 AM, but the electric guitar and background music are extremely loud. It sounds like they're being played right next to my room. It's almost 11 PM, and the noise is very disruptive. Could you please ask the organizers to reduce the volume? I would really like it. Thank you
-- original (ko-US) --

Wiggle room AGAIN is blasting bass and music so loud it’s shaking our walls - send enforcement and FINE THEM.  Why do we have to report them every night?!? Do something about it

Excessive music and pounding bass from Naya Restaurant on West Street vibrate through our shared residential walls , submitted a claim today at 4 PM. Noise is even louder still.  This repeatedly disrupts my home, with no effective resolution. Please investigate noise compliance, require immediate volume reduction, and provide a permanent solution.

Watr at 1Hotel is blatantly ignoring city citations, its cutoff time, and nearby resident complaints about their music and bass being way too loud. It shakes our apartment 3 nights per week and continues past the midnight cutoff every single night. 

The venue also does not yet have a valid OMV permit (and probably shouldn’t get it given its track record). 

Please cut them off…

311’s response that “nothing is wrong” is frustrating because I experience this malfunction regularly. I live near SH 183 & Burleson and commute to Austin-Bergstrom Airport between 5–6 AM. The turn arrows repeatedly fail to cycle, causing major delays and making me late for work. Please have someone inspect the signal during these morning hours rather than relying on a remote check.

Someone at the south end of Rainey before the roundabout is blaring their bass and music. It’s 9 am on a Saturday and I spent the entire night being tortured by music until 2/3 am last night already. And now I can’t even lay in bed to catch up on sleep missed from the blaring bass and music last night. Please fine the f*** out of these people. They do not have any regard holy sh**.

Dog is constantly outside. We moved in the house as of Sep, 7th and every day the dog is always outside regardless of the weather conditions - such as temp over 100 degrees.  
It’s also barking constantly and the noise level is hard to manage. I don’t think the dog is being treated as needed.

Camping evidence in woods at Mabel Davis Park in 2 areas. I can smell campfires in the morning in the woods off Parker behind the skate park and see evidence of trash and clothing items at the edge of the woods off Wickshire entrance to the park behind Montecito apartments. 
Please investigate. This is an ongoing problem in our park and we want to feel safe using the park trail

Stone retaining wall along the front of this property is partially collapsing onto the public sidewalk. Fallen stones, loose blocks, and soil are narrowing the walkway and creating a trip hazard. Please inspect the wall and address the sidewalk obstruction and risk of additional stones falling.

These people park double up in the driveway every day, blocking the sidewalk. This makes our neighbors children have to walk in the street to get to the school bus. It is completely ridiculous considering we have so much street parking, and it is a safety issue for the children. Literally happens every day.

No parking violations. This street has limited visibility due to a hill and yet ever since this large apartment building went up, people regularly park here making the street narrower and risking accidents between vehicles coming from opposite directions. There are 3 no parking signs here.  It is dangerous to come over this hill blindly due to the parking.

We live at 906 Kirschner Place and many months ago they resurfaced our street and surrounding blocks. There are now just piles of loose rocks everywhere that are a safety hazard to children and others riding bikes. Please send the street sweeper before something bad happens.

Contact Customer - Need Additional Information. RC - 10/20/2026 - I went to the location and drove to the intersection of Adirondack and Hyridge Dr. I also drove to the entrance of the Steck Valley Greenbelt but could not observe any tree removal from the ordinary view. I called the telephone number listed in the case file for the complainant to get more details but received no response. I left a

The “cross walk/intersection” of 1626 and Rex D Kitchens needs street lights. I was turning into my apartment complex tonight and totally almost took out a guy. This intersection is becoming difficult enough to navigate with the increase in traffic along here without also having to worry about hitting pedestrians.

Traffic signal malfunction at SH 183 and Burleson Rd. All yellow turn arrows are only flashing yellow instead of cycling to green. Vehicles are stuck in turn lanes for multiple cycles, causing major backups and delays. Please inspect and repair the affected signals.

Large dog left outside unattended in the backyard all day today; this is a recurring pattern. The chain-link gate faces the sidewalk directly. The dog repeatedly barks and lunges at the gate at people walking by, including young children with their parents, who have been crying and screaming. The dogs at this address escaped a few weeks ago and chased a person. Given that history and the gate faci

Major westbound road down to 1 lane in downtown just before 5th/colorado. There is no signage warning people of the lane closures and this is creating massive delays and traffic jams. There is signs that show the there is supposed to be 2 lanes, but that is not correct.

Traffic is backed up all the way to Stassney due to lane closures on Pleasant Valley Road, causing 30 to 45 minutes just to go from the Mendez School/Middle School area to William Cannon. This is unacceptable. Traffic light timing needs to be modified on William Cannon and Pleasant Valley to allow congestion to be alleviated at least.

This language is not acceptable for the general public regardless of an individual’s point of view. I have to drive with my children on the way to school and they don’t need to see this. This is under the freeway at 183 and Anderson.

Watr Rooftop at 1hotel blasting heavy bass at 12:30 am and my bed is shaking 
As a health care professional with early morning schedule, I’m not able to sleep for the 3rd day in a row, running on 3/4 hours of sleep everyday 
I saw some previous complaints on the same venue, repeatedly by different people - why is there no revocation of their permits or any action taken ?

The right lane on both sides of the road here have been closed for a few weeks. There are cones, and instruction signs indicating road closure. It’s been a few weeks and there is no signs of any construction or people working in this area. Why are these signs in place and when will the traffic pattern return to normal?

Developer has left the temporary sidewalk in front of their property in a hazardous condition without closing off the sidewalk/providing an alternative for pedestrians. Can you assist in having the developer complete the sidewalk so pedestrians can safely walk along the other sidewalk the City recently completed?

Watr (1Hotel) is once again blasting their bass and it’s rattling our apartment. It slowly gets louder the later it gets and they don’t abide by their cutoff time.

Please tell ‘em to turn it down and respect the nearby residents.

1 watr hotel blasts outdoor must from rotating DJs every Thursday Friday and Saturday until 2AM. They state this plainly on their website. 

The quincy across the street will allow you to take sound readings from their 30th floor balcony.

Watr Rooftop at 96 Red River Street is once again blasting excessively loud DJ music - it’s near MIDNIGHT 

This is a recurring disturbance, despite previous complaints and documented noise violations.

The heavy bass is shaking my whole Apt 

For response to this ticket  - I request a formal review of the venue’s outdoor music permit for possible suspension or revocation. Repeated citations clear

Bars on Rainey blasted music and bass ALL last night. Then again before 10 am this morning and now all day and it will go into the night. This is egregious. I’m kindly requesting a review of the bars before I genuinely lose my mind. The bass is the worst but i can also hear bands singing outside all the way up in a high rise apartment with double pane windows. Absolutely unreal.

Half step at it EARLY which tells me they’re only going to get louder throughout the night. The subwoofers should be illegal. And I can hear the music from 30, this is crazy. Pls just ask them to turn the bass down. It is pounding. Totally not necessary for them to keep this up… it was like this last night too. 

And just in writing this the levels have increased. Maybe if you get there early, you
